paper.abstract: Rapidly evolving LLM architectures and heterogeneous mobile hardware make supporting new models in on-device inference engines a recurring and costly system challenge. Each model may require coordinated changes across conversion, graph construction, operators, and hardware backends. Existing coding agents often miss these cross-layer dependencies and struggle to diagnose failures across host--device execution paths. We present EngineAgent, an agentic system for automating on-device LLM model enablement. Its key insight is to separate reusable engine and hardware knowledge from model-specific implementation. Before enablement, EngineAgent constructs a hierarchy-aware engine index that captures engine abstraction layers and cross-layer dependencies, and pre-validates backend-specific build, execution, and debugging workflows using already supported models. For each new model, a builder uses this knowledge to coordinate cross-layer changes, while an auditor checks implementation completeness and drives iterative debugging through device-side validation. Across 12 tasks spanning three mobile LLMs and four engine--backend pairs on CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, EngineAgent achieves 75% end-to-end success with either of two underlying LLMs, versus 33.3% for the strongest coding-agent baseline. Success requires compilation, on-device execution, and output-logit agreement with reference implementations. EngineAgent also reduces average per-task time and model-API cost relative to baselines using the same underlying LLMs.
paper.title: EngineAgent: Agentizing On-Device LLM Inference Engines with Inference Stack Hierarchy Awareness and Hardware Abilities

translation.abstract_zh: 快速发展的法学硕士架构和异构移动硬件使得支持设备推理引擎中的新模型成为一项反复出现且成本高昂的系统挑战。每个模型可能需要跨转换、图形构建、运算符和硬件后端进行协调更改。现有的编码代理经常会错过这些跨层依赖关系，并且难以跨主机-设备执行路径诊断故障。我们推出了 EngineAgent，这是一个用于自动化设备上 LLM 模型启用的代理系统。其关键见解是将可重用的引擎和硬件知识与特定于模型的实现分开。在启用之前，EngineAgent 构建一个层次结构感知的引擎索引，捕获引擎抽象层和跨层依赖关系，并使用已支持的模型预先验证特定于后端的构建、执行和调试工作流程。对于每个新模型，构建者使用这些知识来协调跨层更改，而审核员则检查实现完整性并通过设备端验证驱动迭代调试。在涵盖三个移动 LLM 和 CPU、GPU 和 NPU 上的四个引擎后端对的 12 项任务中，EngineAgent 使用两个底层 LLM 中的任何一个实现了 75% 的端到端成功率，而最强的编码代理基线则为 33.3%。成功需要编译、设备上执行以及输出-logit 与参考实现的一致性。相对于使用相同底层 LLM 的基线，EngineAgent 还减少了平均每个任务时间和模型 API 成本。
translation.title_zh: EngineAgent：利用推理堆栈层次结构感知和硬件功能代理设备上 LLM 推理引擎

paper.abstract: Users often complain that AI assistants such as ChatGPT are getting worse. Some versions do change, but human evaluation leaves a second possibility untested: the people judging may change. We separate the two on Chatbot Arena, a public platform where people compare answers from two anonymous large language models (LLMs) and pick the better one or say both are bad. We study 1,260,967 blind votes cast from May 2023 to August 2024 on pairs of models whose versions are fixed: dated vendor snapshots and models with fixed open weights. For the same pair of unchanged models, the share of votes saying "both are bad" rises by 1.71 percentage points a month on a mean of 17.1%, and by 1.91 points a month in 2024. In fourteen pairs observed often in both 2023 and 2024, it rose in every one, from 15.5% to 23.3%. The ranking does not trend: in 2024, the stronger model's share of decisive votes is flat. The rise holds within the same voter and on the same pair, and across arrival cohorts from their first recorded vote. It holds with prompt controls, in every major language, for dated vendor snapshots, open-weight models and models with stable answer length, and between interface changes. The drift is shared across models: month effects estimated from other models' pairs remove it from each model's own pairs. Platform-wide, the average model would be expected to score 78% against the 2023 average, yet the share of "both are bad" votes ended near where it began. The pattern fits a standard that follows the category's progress, so a product that stands still is judged as declining. Absolute verdicts on AI drifted while relative comparisons held steady, an evaluation drift that matters for LLM leaderboards and for the human feedback used to train models.
paper.title: AI Isn't Getting Dumber, We're Getting Pickier: Rising Standards in Human Evaluation of Large Language Models

translation.abstract_zh: Users often complain that AI assistants such as ChatGPT are getting worse. Some versions do change, but human evaluation leaves a second possibility untested: the people judging may change.我们在 Chatbot Arena 上将两者分开，这是一个公共平台，人们可以在该平台上比较两个匿名大语言模型 (LLM) 的答案，然后选择更好的一个或说两个都不好。我们研究了从 2023 年 5 月到 2024 年 8 月对版本固定的模型对进行的 1,260,967 次盲选：过时的供应商快照和具有固定开放权重的模型。对于同一对未改变的型号，表示“两者都不好”的投票比例每月上升 1.71 个百分点，平均为 17.1%，到 2024 年每月上升 1.91 个百分点。在 2023 年和 2024 年经常观察到的 14 对中，每一对的投票比例都上升，从 15.5% 上升到 23.3%。 The ranking does not trend: in 2024, the stronger model's share of decisive votes is flat. The rise holds within the same voter and on the same pair, and across arrival cohorts from their first recorded vote.它支持各种主要语言的提示控制，适用于过时的供应商快照、开放权重模型和具有稳定答案长度的模型以及界面更改之间的模型。 The drift is shared across models: month effects estimated from other models' pairs remove it from each model's own pairs.在整个平台范围内，与 2023 年的平均水平相比，平均模型的得分预计为 78%，但“两者都不好”的投票比例最终接近开始时的水平。 The pattern fits a standard that follows the category's progress, so a product that stands still is judged as declining.对人工智能的绝对判断发生了漂移，而相对比较保持稳定，这种评估漂移对于法学硕士排行榜和用于训练模型的人类反馈至关重要。
translation.title_zh: 人工智能并没有变得更笨，而是我们变得更挑剔：人类对大型语言模型的评估标准不断提高

paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon, verifier-rich environments, but current self-improvement mechanisms often write episode-derived lessons directly into memory, making local success an unreliable signal for reusable and safe knowledge. This paper addresses the core question of when an experience-derived behavioral update should be admitted into persistent agent state. We propose Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution (FGSE), a verifier-grounded framework that represents each candidate lesson as a structured hypothesis with an explicit precondition, behavior change, expected effect, and verifier. FGSE applies the hypothesis only in a temporary state, tests it on target-transfer, falsification, and archived-regression probes, and then commits, refines, or rejects it according to measured gain and risk. Across web, app, tool-use, and long-term memory benchmarks, FGSE achieves strong task performance, including 39.8 WebArena success rate, 78.8 AppWorld average completion, and 0.724/0.487 Pass$^1$ on $τ$-Retail/$τ$-Airline, while reducing falsification failures to 5.0%, regression damage to 1.3%, and harmful committed updates to 3.6%. These results suggest that testing memory updates as hypotheses supports more reliable long-term adaptation.
paper.title: When Should Agents Remember? Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution for LLM Agents

translation.abstract_zh: LLM 代理越来越多地在长期、验证者丰富的环境中运行，但当前的自我改进机制经常将源自事件的教训直接写入内存，使得局部成功成为可重用和安全知识的不可靠信号。本文解决了何时应将基于经验的行为更新纳入持久代理状态的核心问题。我们提出了证伪门控自我进化（FGSE），这是一个基于验证者的框架，它将每个候选课程表示为具有明确前提条件、行为变化、预期效果和验证者的结构化假设。 FGSE 仅在临时状态下应用假设，在目标转移、伪造和存档回归探针上对其进行测试，然后根据测量的收益和风险提交、完善或拒绝它。在 Web、应用程序、工具使用和长期内存基准测试中，FGSE 实现了强大的任务性能，包括 39.8 的 WebArena 成功率、78.8 的 AppWorld 平均完成率以及 $τ$-Retail/$τ$-Airline 上的 0.724/0.487 Pass$^1$，同时将伪造失败率降低至 5.0%，回归损坏率降低至 1.3%，有害提交更新率降低至 3.6%。这些结果表明，将记忆更新作为假设进行测试支持更可靠的长期适应。
translation.title_zh: 代理人应该何时记住？ LLM 代理的证伪门控自我进化

paper.abstract: Language-model systems use self-judgment to decide which answers to release, review, or recompute. Because intervention is costly, an assurance score must rank errors well at the available budget, not merely over the full ranking. We compare the judge's continuous verdict-token score with a supervised correctness probe trained on attention-head activations from the same prompt. Exact identities link fixed-budget error recall to residual risk and show that AUROC averages recall over all budgets. Across three open 7-12B models on GSM8K and MATH, the probe finds 1.3-22.5 additional percentage points of errors at 5% review in all six model-dataset settings (median 7.4 points). At 10% routing, probe-guided allocation improves accuracy over equal-cost random allocation in both GSM8K experiments, but beats judge-guided routing only for the weaker judge. Cross-dataset transfer lowers probe AUROC for every model in both directions relative to target-domain training. Because dataset, weight precision, and generation budget change together, this measures a joint protocol shift rather than a dataset-only effect. Internal signals can improve supervised, in-domain budget allocation, but are not domain-general confidence estimators.
paper.title: Auditing the Judge: Internal Signals for LLM Reasoning Assurance

translation.abstract_zh: 语言模型系统使用自我判断来决定发布、审查或重新计算哪些答案。由于干预成本高昂，因此保证分数必须在可用预算内对错误进行良好排名，而不仅仅是在完整排名上。我们将法官的连续判决标记分数与受同一提示下的注意力头激活训练的监督正确性探针进行比较。精确的恒等式将固定预算错误召回与剩余风险联系起来，并表明 AUROC 对所有预算的召回进行平均。在 GSM8K 和 MATH 上的三个开放 7-12B 模型中，探针在所有六个模型数据集设置中发现 5% 审查时存在 1.3-22.5 个额外百分点的错误（中位数 7.4 个百分点）。在 10% 路由时，在 GSM8K 实验中，探测引导分配比等成本随机分配提高了准确性，但仅在较弱的判断上优于判断引导路由。相对于目标域训练，跨数据集传输降低了每个模型在两个方向上的探测 AUROC。由于数据集、权重精度和发电预算一起变化，因此这衡量的是联合协议转变，而不是仅数据集的影响。内部信号可以改进受监督的域内预算分配，但不是域通用置信估计器。
translation.title_zh: 审计法官：法学硕士推理保证的内部信号

paper.abstract: External memory enables LLM agents to improve from experience by distilling trajectories of past tasks into concise lessons for new tasks. However, memory can also lead to memory-induced degradation, where an agent fails on tasks it would solve without memory, often because it follows a lesson that is incorrect, or misapplies or misreads a valid one. This is because lessons are inferred from trajectories labeled only with task success or failure, yet are typically provided without the trajectories they came from, leaving the agent no way to check them. To address this, we introduce WikiTrace, an evidence-linked memory system designed to let agents check each lesson against its original trajectory. Specifically, motivated by the finding that a trajectory often still holds the evidence needed to catch an erroneous lesson, WikiTrace stores each lesson as a concise insight linked to a summary of why its trajectory succeeded or failed and to the raw trajectory itself. Then, on a new task, the agent starts from all insights and, whenever one lacks details needed to act, conflicts with another, or comes from a failed task, descends through its links with terminal tools to fill in missing details or correct the insight before acting. We validate WikiTrace on five agentic benchmarks, showing that it consistently outperforms existing memory approaches and a baseline given the same insights alone, while also reducing memory-induced degradation. Our code is available at https://github.com/yukyeongleee/wikitrace
paper.title: Don't Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents

translation.abstract_zh: 外部记忆使 LLM 代理能够通过将过去任务的轨迹提炼成新任务的简洁教训来从经验中进行改进。然而，记忆也可能导致记忆引起的退化，即代理在没有记忆的情况下无法完成其可以解决的任务，通常是因为它遵循了不正确的教训，或者误用或误读了有效的教训。这是因为经验教训是从仅标记任务成功或失败的轨迹中推断出来的，但通常没有提供它们来自的轨迹，使代理无法检查它们。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 WikiTrace，这是一种与证据相关的记忆系统，旨在让代理根据其原始轨迹检查每节课程。具体来说，由于发现轨迹通常仍然包含捕捉错误教训所需的证据，WikiTrace 将每个教训存储为简洁的见解，与轨迹成功或失败原因的摘要以及原始轨迹本身相关联。然后，在一项新任务中，代理从所有洞察开始，每当一个缺乏行动所需的细节、与另一个人发生冲突或来自失败的任务时，代理就会通过其与终端工具的链接下降，以填充缺失的细节或在行动之前纠正洞察。我们在五个代理基准上验证了 WikiTrace，结果表明它始终优于现有的内存方法和单独给出相同见解的基线，同时还减少了内存引起的退化。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/yukyeongleee/wikitrace 获取
translation.title_zh: 不要只相信你的记忆：与证据相关的记忆可以减少法学硕士代理中记忆引起的退化

paper.abstract: Evaluating candidate parallelization strategies through distributed training runs makes strategy selection prohibitively expensive at scale. Performance simulation offers a lower cost alternative, yet controlled comparisons among existing simulators remain difficult because they differ in the training stages they model and the workloads on which they are evaluated. We introduce LM-SimBench, a unified framework, profiling dataset, and benchmark for evaluating LLM training simulators. The framework decomposes simulation into functional stages from model compilation to schedule level aggregation, connecting execution representations and cost estimators to measurable evaluation targets. Following this framework, we profile 23 model settings from 10 dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLM families on an Ascend Neural Processing Unit (NPU) cluster. The resulting dataset contains 348 feasible configurations that jointly vary five parallelism dimensions and activation recomputation, with six views spanning configuration, rank, operator, event, and kernel granularity. Evaluations of representative training simulators demonstrate how LM-SimBench supports comparisons of prediction accuracy, assessment of configuration selection, and diagnosis of prediction errors. Matched GPU-NPU experiments validate the cross-platform applicability of the collection and evaluation protocol and demonstrate NPU-guided GPU configuration selection.
paper.title: LM-SimBench: A Unified Framework, Dataset, and Benchmark for Large Language Model Training Simulation

translation.abstract_zh: 通过分布式训练运行评估候选并行化策略使得大规模策略选择的成本过高。性能模拟提供了一种成本更低的替代方案，但现有模拟器之间的受控比较仍然很困难，因为它们在建模的训练阶段和评估的工作负载方面存在差异。我们介绍 LM-SimBench，这是一个统一的框架、分析数据集和用于评估 LLM 训练模拟器的基准。该框架将模拟分解为从模型编译到调度级别聚合的功能阶段，将执行表示和成本估算器连接到可测量的评估目标。遵循这个框架，我们在 Ascend 神经处理单元 (NPU) 集群上分析了来自 10 个密集型专家混合 (MoE) LLM 系列的 23 个模型设置。生成的数据集包含 348 个可行的配置，这些配置共同改变五个并行维度和激活重新计算，具有跨越配置、排名、运算符、事件和内核粒度的六个视图。对代表性训练模拟器的评估展示了 LM-SimBench 如何支持预测精度的比较、配置选择的评估以及预测错误的诊断。 GPU-NPU 匹配实验验证了采集和评估协议的跨平台适用性，并演示了 NPU 引导的 GPU 配置选择。
translation.title_zh: LM-SimBench：大型语言模型训练仿真的统一框架、数据集和基准

paper.abstract: Fault diagnosis in complex systems requires linking observed changes in physical quantities to the failure mechanisms that produce them. Experienced engineers perform this task by combining sensor information with knowledge of system behavior and fault propagation. Large Language Models (LLMs) can support this process, but their diagnostic reasoning depends on the availability of asset-specific engineering knowledge and on how this knowledge is represented and used during inference. This work introduces Chain of Physics (CoP), an LLM-based fault-diagnosis framework built around a Constrained Knowledge Graph (CKG) generated automatically from asset-specific reference documentation. CoP addresses failure-sensor association from textual engineering knowledge. The CKG stores diagnostic chains connecting failure modes, changes in physical quantities, and monitoring sensors. During inference, semantically similar graph paths are retrieved for each question and used as both information and in-context examples for the reasoning process. Candidate failure modes are extracted from the question and analysed independently through dedicated LLM calls, which generate plausible failure-to-observation chains. A final decision module compares these chains with the available answer choices. CoP is evaluated on the FailureSensorIQ benchmark across four industrial asset classes and three LLMs. Compared with direct prompting and conventional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), CoP improves diagnostic accuracy across all evaluated models, with gains ranging from 7.8 to 19.6 percentage points and from 11.7 to 18.2 percentage points, respectively. The results show that structured engineering knowledge can improve LLM-based diagnostic reasoning when graph retrieval is combined with in-context examples of fault propagation.
paper.title: Chain of Physics: Supporting Fault Diagnosis with Engineering-Inspired Large Language Model Reasoning

translation.abstract_zh: 复杂系统中的故障诊断需要将观察到的物理量变化与产生这些变化的故障机制联系起来。经验丰富的工程师通过将传感器信息与系统行为和故障传播的知识相结合来执行此任务。大型语言模型 (LLM) 可以支持此过程，但其诊断推理取决于特定于资产的工程知识的可用性以及这些知识在推理过程中的表示和使用方式。这项工作介绍了物理链 (CoP)，这是一种基于法学硕士的故障诊断框架，围绕从特定资产的参考文档自动生成的约束知识图 (CKG) 构建。 CoP 从文本工程知识中解决故障与传感器的关联问题。 CKG 存储连接故障模式、物理量变化和监控传感器的诊断链。在推理过程中，为每个问题检索语义相似的图形路径，并将其用作推理过程的信息和上下文示例。从问题中提取候选故障模式，并通过专用的 LLM 调用进行独立分析，从而生成合理的故障观察链。最终决策模块将这些链与可用的答案选择进行比较。 CoP 根据 FailureSensorIQ 基准对四个工业资产类别和三个法学硕士进行评估。与直接提示和传统的检索增强生成 (RAG) 相比，CoP 提高了所有评估模型的诊断准确性，分别提高了 7.8 至 19.6 个百分点和 11.7 至 18.2 个百分点。结果表明，当图检索与故障传播的上下文示例相结合时，结构化工程知识可以改进基于 LLM 的诊断推理。
translation.title_zh: 物理链：以工程启发的大语言模型推理支持故障诊断

paper.abstract: Hybrid models combine softmax attention with linear attention, which compresses history into fixed-size recurrent states to balance model quality and inference efficiency. However, linear attention has not pushed this compression to its limit: we find that the queries, keys, and values of linear layers concentrate in a stable, low-dimensional subspace, a phenomenon we call the linear attention sink, so each state is effectively low-rank, with a rank that varies across states. Yet existing serving systems keep these redundant states dense, reading and rewriting them in full at every decoding step, so their memory traffic grows with the batch size and dominates the decoding cost. Thus SinkState stores each recurrent state in an adaptive low-rank form throughout inference with buffered updates and a local SVD restricted to the top subspace. SinkState further consolidates the remaining components asynchronously on the CPU. On four hybrid models with Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, from 4B to 120B parameters, SinkState reduces the peak memory of recurrent states by up to 2.6x (1.9x on average) and speeds up decoding by up to 1.58x (1.25x on average) over Mamba-SSM and FLA, while maintaining accuracy.
paper.title: SinkState: On-the-Fly SVD of Recurrent States for Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving

translation.abstract_zh: 混合模型将 softmax 注意力与线性注意力相结合，将历史压缩为固定大小的循环状态，以平衡模型质量和推理效率。然而，线性注意力并没有将这种压缩推向极限：我们发现线性层的查询、键和值集中在一个稳定的低维子空间中，我们将这种现象称为线性注意力池，因此每个状态实际上都是低秩的，并且各个状态的秩不同。然而，现有的服务系统使这些冗余状态保持密集，在每个解码步骤中完整地读取和重写它们，因此它们的内存流量随着批量大小而增长，并主导解码成本。因此，SinkState 在整个推理过程中以自适应低秩形式存储每个循环状态，并使用缓冲更新和仅限于顶部子空间的本地 SVD。 SinkState 进一步在 CPU 上异步整合其余组件。在具有 Mamba-2 和门控 DeltaNet (GDN) 层的四个混合模型上，从 4B 到 120B 参数，与 Mamba-SSM 和 FLA 相比，SinkState 将循环状态的峰值内存减少高达 2.6 倍（平均 1.9 倍），并将解码速度提高高达 1.58 倍（平均 1.25 倍），同时保持准确性。
translation.title_zh: SinkState：用于高效混合 LLM 服务的循环状态的动态 SVD

paper.abstract: We present an AI assistant for automating anti-corruption expertise of draft legislation based on the TRACE architecture, designed to screen bills for corruption risks: pinpoint provisions an expert would criticise and name the regulatory defect in each. The pipeline combines a deterministic parsing core, model-guided single-provision qualification, rule-based factor assignment, and external human oversight. To evaluate the assistant, we constructed an open benchmark from the published conclusions of Ukraine's National Agency on Corruption Prevention (NAZK), comprising 132 draft laws with 474 model-extracted findings. A system flag agrees with a finding when it targets a compatible provision and an LLM judge rates the risk as the same (strict) or partly the same (lenient). On 100 draft laws, the pipeline matches 0.28 of the findings within its top ten flags using the local Gemma 4 31B model, 0.30 with Sonnet 5.5, and 0.43-0.46 across all flags (non-blind; the frozen blind baseline achieves 0.21, 95% CI 0.16-0.26). Across all runs, most misses occur on provisions that the system located but qualified as a different risk, and none of the 32 legal-collision findings was matched. On 21 acts held out from tuning, the pipeline outperforms a monolithic prompt containing the full methodology under the strict measure, though not under the lenient one, and Opus 5.5 adds nothing over Sonnet. The reported scores reflect agreement with model-extracted findings rated by an LLM judge whose two access routes agree on 73 of 74 labels, without human expert validation.
paper.title: An AI Assistant for Automating Anti-Corruption Expertise of Draft Legislation Based on the TRACE Framework

translation.abstract_zh: 我们推出了一款人工智能助手，用于自动执行基于 TRACE 架构的立法草案的反腐败专业知识，旨在筛选法案中的腐败风险：查明专家会批评的条款，并指出每个条款中的监管缺陷。该管道结合了确定性解析核心、模型引导的单规定限定、基于规则的因素分配和外部人工监督。为了评估该助手，我们根据乌克兰国家预防腐败局 (NAZK) 公布的结论构建了一个开放基准，其中包括 132 项法律草案和 474 项模型提取结果。当系统标志针对兼容条款并且法学硕士法官将风险评级为相同（严格）或部分相同（宽松）时，系统标志与调查结果一致。在 100 份法律草案中，管道使用本地 Gemma 4 31B 模型匹配其前十个标志中的结果中的 0.28，使用 Sonnet 5.5 匹配 0.30，所有标志匹配 0.43-0.46（非盲；冻结盲基线达到 0.21，95% CI 0.16-0.26）。在所有运行中，大多数遗漏都发生在系统找到但被认定为不同风险的规定上，并且 32 个法律冲突结果均不匹配。在需要调整的 21 首曲目中，该管道在严格的衡量标准下优于包含完整方法的整体提示，但在宽松的衡量标准下则不然，而且 Opus 5.5 与 Sonnet 相比没有添加任何内容。报告的分数反映了与法学硕士法官评分的模型提取结果的一致性，该法官的两条访问路径在 74 个标签中的 73 个上一致，无需人类专家验证。
translation.title_zh: 基于TRACE框架的立法草案反腐败专业知识自动化人工智能助手

paper.abstract: Variability in syntactic structure and parsing ambiguity are fundamental aspects of natural language which modern LLMs have to learn to deal with proficiently. Previous "post-mortem" studies have shown that fully trained Transformers indeed approximate canonical parsing algorithms such as inside-outside, but little is established theoretically about how this is actually learned. Here, we make a first step towards addressing this by studying the learning dynamics in synthetic context-free grammars with variable parse tree topology. The stagewise learning curves are fully interpretable, in the sense that all of the loss stages a) can be computed analytically, and b) can be clearly associated to the representation of a hidden latent tree variable, which allows to lift ambiguity and utilize information from wider contexts. By probing representations, we visualize the emergence of inside-outside computation across depth and during training: while during early stages local (bigram/trigram) information is used and involves only a few initial layers, gradually the Transformer develops an encoder-decoder structure where the most abstract latent information is encoded in the middle, and the latter half of the network is used to progressively refine the final token prediction. This organization of computation is reminiscent of findings in real-world LLMs, and importantly applies here to a synthetic model which allows full analytical control of the data statistics, thus opening the door to theoretical progress.
paper.title: Stagewise and interpretable emergence of inside-outside computation in Transformer-based language models

translation.abstract_zh: 句法结构的可变性和解析歧义是现代法学硕士必须学会熟练处理的自然语言的基本方面。先前的“事后分析”研究表明，经过充分训练的 Transformer 确实近似于规范解析算法，例如内部-外部，但关于如何实际学习的理论却很少。在这里，我们通过研究具有变量解析树拓扑的合成上下文无关语法的学习动态来解决这个问题迈出了第一步。分阶段学习曲线是完全可解释的，因为所有损失阶段 a) 都可以分析计算，b) 可以清楚地与隐藏的潜在树变量的表示相关联，这允许消除歧义并利用来自更广泛上下文的信息。通过探测表示，我们可视化跨深度和训练过程中内外计算的出现：虽然在早期阶段使用本地（二元组/三元组）信息并且仅涉及几个初始层，但 Transformer 逐渐开发出一种编码器-解码器结构，其中最抽象的潜在信息在中间进行编码，而网络的后半部分用于逐步细化最终的标记预测。这种计算组织让人想起现实世界法学硕士的发现，并且重要的是这里适用于允许对数据统计进行全面分析控制的综合模型，从而为理论进步打开了大门。
translation.title_zh: 基于 Transformer 的语言模型中内外计算的阶段性和可解释性出现
